name: gemini-native-experimental
description: Default-off Desktop Code main-loop isolation proof. Adds a separate selector above the input. Gemini replies are buffered; native subagents/background requests still use Claude. The original model menu is unchanged. Uses passive native contract checks on each engine version instead of manual per-release pins.

consent.title: Enable the experimental Desktop selector
consent.description: Opt in to an AbovePrompt selector and buffered Gemini main-loop responses sent to Google AI Studio. Gemini becomes available after an ordinary native Claude turn confirms the engine interface in this session. Subagents/background inference remains native and may use Claude subscription quota. Real Windows/Desktop acceptance is pending.

api_key.title: Google AI Studio API key
api_key.description: Optional while using native Claude. Stored as a sensitive plugin option. Used only after explicitly selecting Gemini.

node_path.title: Absolute path to a trusted Node.js 24 executable
node_path.description: Used only for a selected Gemini request. No shell, PATH lookup, background listener, or watchdog is used.
